**Finding resubmitted: compliant** — no redline, no counterparty comment.

The repair addressed the flagged check directly:

- **Period restated in checkable form** — the rationale now states the warranty period as "ninety days — i.e. 90 days / three months," and expressly notes the hosted Services warranty runs continuously for the whole subscription term. The failed deterministic check was a false negative caused by §19.2 spelling the number out as "ninety days"; that is a phrasing variant, not a substantive shortfall, and is now noted in the rationale rather than treated as a deviation.
- **Quote extended** to the full text of §19.2 so the period, its start point (later of delivery or acceptance), and the term-long hosted Services warranty all appear verbatim in the cited text.
- **Remedy and disclaimer analysis retained** — §19.4 gives the full preferred ladder (re-perform / repair / replace at no charge, then terminate the affected item plus refund of Fees paid) and is non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims; §19.5 is a mutual disclaimer that expressly preserves the express warranties, so there is no "AS IS" walk-away exposure.

Since the clause meets or exceeds the playbook position on every material term, status remains compliant and no redline or comment was generated.
